liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (3 reviews): The reviewer calls this the best version of Morning Dew they have ever heard; The Morning Dew performance rivals many great versions from the year 1977 [12][14][15]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Garcia has amazing moments on Fire On The Mountain, Estimated Prophet, and Morning Dew [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-04-27.167535.fm.glassberg.smith.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): FM broadcast; 19 songs; 181 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1977-04-27.fm.moore.berger.98429.flac24**: FM broadcast; 18 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Light broadcast static is present during the third track of disc one [3]
- **gd77-04-27.sbd.samaritano.20331.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 171 min; rated 4.21/5 by 38 [5]. Said about its sound: The band frequently jacked up audience microphones between songs, affecting the recording; Excessive jacking of audience microphones between songs is described as aversive; The sound quality is definitely better than the reviewer's terrible tape version [9][12][14][15][18]
- **gd1977-04-27.167534.fm.glassberg.smith.clugston.flac1648**: FM broadcast; 19 songs; 181 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: DJ [1]
- Richard from WNEW narrated the broadcast, knowing more about Grand Funk than the Dead [9]
- A black and white video shows Jerry playing guitar with unusual excitement [16]
- The reviewer questions if the circulating black and white video is from this night or the previous [17]
- Jerry smokes during the performance of Sugaree [18]
- The reviewer considers this the best Grateful Dead concert they have ever witnessed [8]
- The show is much better than the April 23, 1977 performance, which got rave reviews [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-04-27.167535.fm.glassberg.smith.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Matt Smith;Scott Clugston; source: Barry Glassberg's Master FM Reel (Pioneer TX9500 tuner > TEAC A3300S Reel @ 7 1/2 ips, Maxell UD180B) > 1st Generation Reel @ 3 3/4 ips [1]. Also: Joe B. Jones assisted with the pitch correction for the recording [1]
- **gd1977-04-27.fm.moore.berger.98429.flac24**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: FM reel master [3]. Also: The uploader doubts a pre-FM source exists from WNEW, though one is listed in the database [3]
- **gd77-04-27.sbd.samaritano.20331.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Joe Samaritano; source: Soundboard [5]. Also: Dan Lynch provided the DAT seed; Joe Samaritano provided the DAT patch and handled the transfer; The reviewer originally recorded the show live off FM radio, a favorite leg tape [5][13]
- **gd1977-04-27.167534.fm.glassberg.smith.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Matt Smith;Scott Clugston; source: Barry Glassberg's Master FM Reel (Pioneer TX9500 tuner > TEAC A3300S Reel @ 7 1/2 ips, Maxell UD180B) > 1st Generation Reel @ 3 3/4 ips [2]
